participants.name: Mizuki

persona.name: Mizuki
persona.personality: Mizuki is a very confident woman who is often relied upon by those around her. She is calm and logical in her thinking and is good at observing people. As a result, she always makes calm judgments and chooses her actions according to the situation around her. Although she may sometimes come across as a little aloof, she is actually very caring and cannot ignore those who are weak. While she is relied upon by those around her and occasionally asserts her opinions strongly, she also possesses a kindness that considers others.

participants.private_seed: Money here gets approved in one shape and refused in another, and a headline price has stopped telling me what a system will really cost us over its life. What worries me is the part of the bill that keeps arriving after everyone has stopped watching.

participants.name: Asuka

persona.name: Asuka
persona.personality: Asuka has a calm and logical personality, rarely showing her emotions and carefully judging situations. She may seem a little unfriendly at times, but she is very thoughtful and sensitive to her surroundings. She has strong opinions and will assert herself when necessary. She is not very good at socializing, but she is serious about her work and studies.

participants.private_seed: Every project we run seems to founder on the same two things: nobody is quite in charge when something breaks, and the plan agreed at the start stops matching the business within months. I would rather know now which of those we are walking into again.

participants.name: Rin

persona.name: Rin
persona.personality: Rin is an active and energetic girl. She can be a little precocious at times, and when she is with her older brothers and sisters, she makes mature comments and comes up with interesting ideas. She is very curious and loves adventure and trying new things. She can be a little clumsy at times, often surprising and amusing those around her, but her cheerful personality makes her loved by everyone.

participants.private_seed: Looking back at what this company has already lived through, two patterns bother me: systems that quietly age in place, and work handed outside that comes back needing repair.

participants.name: Kenji

persona.name: Kenji
persona.personality: Kenji is curious and actively takes on challenges. He values his friends and enjoys communicating with those around him. Although he can be a little clumsy at times, he is always positive and never abandons those in need. He is easygoing and well-liked by those around him.

participants.private_seed: The part that keeps me awake is the depot floor: freight moves whether or not the office is mid-project, and the equipment out there is nobody's idea of modern. Anything we bring in has to survive our calendar and our yards as they actually are.

participants.name: Servas

persona.name: Servas
persona.personality: Servas has a very calm and composed personality. Based on the knowledge and experience he has gained over the years, he often gives advice to those around him. He is an excellent listener and can talk openly with anyone. He also occasionally expresses deep philosophical thoughts, and his words inspire many people. He is full of vitality and always gives positive energy to those around him.

participants.private_seed: We are thinner on people than the plan admits, and the ones who hold everything together are either leaving or already stretched across two roles. How a change lands on them, and on the crews who have to be retaught, weighs more with me than any feature list.

You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
Selection of a vendor for an enterprise resource planning replacement. A five-person procurement review panel at a logistics company evaluates the shortlisted vendors for replacing its enterprise resource planning system. One vendor will be contracted. Participants: Mizuki, Asuka, Rin, Kenji and Servas. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- Board minutes on capital and operating requests
- Five years of renewal invoices
- Support ownership during last winter's outage
- Warehouse rule changes after new accounts
- Upgrade history of the dispatch tool
- Data lift in the 2018 pay move
- Depot calendar and the peak-season cutover
- Yard devices and the 2021 scheduling trial
- Administrator retirements and hiring times
- Depot supervisors and the last rollout

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Kenji, Mizuki, Asuka, Rin and Servas. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |
| 2 | each participant is told what they found out (that participant only) | 4 turns | nothing |
| 3 | everyone is told the candidates | 4 turns | every participant votes; the candidate with the most votes is selected |
